# orders-api configuration module (ECS)

Generated by `docuconf terraform -target ecs` from the `orders-api` contract. It takes one argument per input, checks it against the contract, and renders an ECS container definition's `environment` and `secrets`. See [spec/IAC.md](https://github.com/Docuconf/docuconf-go/blob/main/spec/IAC.md).

| Input | Type | Required | Set with | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ALLOWED_ORIGINS` | list of string, csv |  | `value`, `injected` | Origins allowed to call the API from a browser |
| `DATABASE_URL` | url, secret | yes | `secret`, `injected` | Postgres connection string for the orders database |
| `LOG_LEVEL` | enum |  | `value`, `injected` | Minimum log level emitted |
| `PORT` | int |  | `value`, `injected` | HTTP listen port |
| `REQUEST_TIMEOUT` | duration |  | `value`, `injected` | Time limit for handling one request |
| `WEBHOOK_KEYS` | keySet, secret |  | `secret`, `injected` | Keys that verify the signature on incoming payment webhooks |
| `WORKER_COUNT` | int |  | `value`, `injected` | Number of background workers processing orders |

ECS mounts no files, so the contract's optional file inputs and overlays are not part of this module.

A secret's `value_from` is a Secrets Manager ARN, a Parameter Store ARN, or the name of either in the task's own account and region. `json_key`, `version_stage` and `version_id` select from a Secrets Manager secret. The task execution role must be allowed to read each secret (`secretsmanager:GetSecretValue`, `ssm:GetParameters`).

## Usage

```hcl
module "orders_api_config" {
  source = "./modules/orders-api-config"
  DATABASE_URL = { secret = { value_from = aws_secretsmanager_secret.database_url.arn } }
}

resource "aws_ecs_task_definition" "app" {
  # …
  container_definitions = jsonencode([{
    name        = "orders-api"
    image       = var.image
    environment = module.orders_api_config.ecs_environment
    secrets     = module.orders_api_config.ecs_secrets

}
```
